biomarker_master_table_ttd.biomarker_id: internal TTD biomarker identifier — join key only
biomarker_master_table_ttd.biomarker_name: name of the biomarker associated with a disease, stored as a full protein descriptor with the symbol in parentheses; e.g. 'Erbb2 tyrosine kinase receptor (HER2)', 'GTPase KRas (KRAS)', 'Tyrosine-protein kinase Kit (SCFR)', 'Programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)'; used when asking for disease biomarkers

disease_master_table_ttd.disease_id: internal TTD disease identifier — join key only
disease_master_table_ttd.disease_name: name of the disease, medical condition, or therapeutic indication (TTD uses British spelling, e.g. 'leukaemia'); e.g. Non-small-cell lung cancer, Chronic myelogenous leukaemia, Type 2 diabetes mellitus, Breast cancer, Alzheimer disease, Hypertension

drug_crossmatching_association_ttd.formula: molecular formula of the drug; e.g. C29H31N7O; used when asking for elemental composition
drug_crossmatching_association_ttd.crossmatch_pubchem_cid: PubChem compound identifier stored as a STRING of digits (not an integer); e.g. "5291" for imatinib; used when looking up PubChem CID — filter values must be quoted strings
drug_crossmatching_association_ttd.cas_number: CAS Registry Number for the drug; 99.8% of values carry a literal 'CAS ' prefix on disk (e.g. "CAS 152459-95-5"); filter values MUST include the 'CAS ' prefix to match
drug_crossmatching_association_ttd.chebi_xref: ChEBI compound identifier cross-reference; e.g. CHEBI:45783; used when asking for ChEBI ID
drug_crossmatching_association_ttd.superdrug_atc: SuperDrug ATC code cross-reference — xref/join key
drug_crossmatching_association_ttd.superdrug_cas: SuperDrug CAS number cross-reference — xref/join key

drug_disease_association_ttd.approval_status: clinical approval or development stage of the drug for this indication; e.g. Approved, Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, Investigative, Patented, Preclinical, Terminated, Discontinued in Phase 2, Withdrawn from market

drug_master_table_ttd.drug_id: internal TTD drug identifier (e.g. D0Y2ZZ) — join key only
drug_master_table_ttd.drug_name: name of the drug, compound, or therapeutic agent; e.g. imatinib, erlotinib, pembrolizumab, nivolumab, bevacizumab, gefitinib, cetuximab, trastuzumab

drug_synonyms_association_ttd.synonym: alternate name, brand name, or trade name for the drug; e.g. Gleevec for imatinib, Herceptin for trastuzumab, Keytruda for pembrolizumab

drug_target_association_ttd.drug_mechanism_of_action_on_target: mechanism by which the drug acts on its target; e.g. Inhibitor, Agonist, Antagonist, Blocker, Activator, Modulator, Binder; used when asking how a drug works or its mode of action (MoA). 2,251 of 45,234 rows (5.0%) have an empty-string MoA (no mechanism recorded) — these are valid drug-target links where the mechanism is unknown. Filter with != '' to restrict to named MoAs.

pathway_master_table_ttd.pathway_id: internal TTD/KEGG pathway identifier — join key only
pathway_master_table_ttd.pathway_name: name of the biological signaling or metabolic pathway; e.g. MAPK signaling pathway, PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, Apoptosis, Wnt signaling, mTOR signaling pathway

target_compound_activity_association_ttd.drug_compound_id: TTD drug ID (D-prefix) or raw compound ID (C-prefix) for the compound — internal xref key
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.compound_activity_pubchem_cid: PubChem compound identifier for the tested compound — xref/join key
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.activity_raw: raw activity value string as reported in the source literature, e.g. '0.5 nM', '10 uM' — internal provenance column
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.activity_type: type of bioactivity measurement; exactly three values on disk: IC50, Ki, EC50 (Kd does not appear in TTD); used when asking for activity type
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.activity_operator: relational operator on the activity value; e.g. =, <, >; internal precision qualifier
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.activity_value: numeric bioactivity value (Float64 on disk); e.g. 0.5, 10, 100; used when filtering by potency or activity value
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.activity_unit: unit of the bioactivity measurement; the only non-null value on disk is nM (all potency stored in nanomolar); used when filtering by unit or scale
target_compound_activity_association_ttd.compound_activity_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol (denormalised) for the target — used for gene-level filtering without a join; multi-gene targets are stored as a single '; '-joined value (e.g. 'TNNI1; TNNI2; TNNI3')

target_master_table_ttd.target_id: internal TTD target identifier (e.g. T47101) — join key only
target_master_table_ttd.target_name: full name of the biological target (protein, receptor, enzyme, ion channel) INCLUDING the gene symbol in parentheses as stored on disk; e.g. Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), Serine/threonine-protein kinase B-raf (BRAF), Programmed cell death protein 1 (PDCD1)
target_master_table_ttd.gene_symbol: official HGNC gene symbol for the target; e.g. EGFR, BRAF, PDCD1, ABL1, KDR; root column for gene-level queries — multi-gene target complexes carry one row per constituent gene, so a single symbol resolves its target

target_uniprot_association_ttd.uniprot_xref: UniProt entry name / mnemonic (NOT accession) cross-reference for the target; e.g. EGFR_HUMAN, BRAF_HUMAN, ABL1_HUMAN; multiple values are joined with '; '; used when asking for the UniProt entry name / protein identifier. 613 rows carry the sentinel value 'NOUNIPROTAC' indicating the target has no UniProt accession assigned. Filter with != 'NOUNIPROTAC' to restrict to real accessions.
target_uniprot_association_ttd.target_type: TTD target development class; exactly six long-form values: Successful target, Clinical trial target, Literature-reported target, Patented-recorded target, Discontinued target, Preclinical target; used when filtering by target development stage
target_uniprot_association_ttd.uniprot_target_name: target name (denormalised) — used to identify the target in UniProt context
target_uniprot_association_ttd.uniprot_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol (denormalised mirror) for the target — decoration column; multi-gene targets are stored as a single '; '-joined value; do not use as root for gene-symbol queries (prefer target_master_table)
